name: Failed v2 callback for invalid RTP transition - DS-08N negative compliant
description:
DS_08N RJCT callback sent twice on the same RTP (direct SENT -> REJECTED).

The second callback must be rejected with 400 since the transition is no
longer valid once the RTP is already REJECTED.
descriptionHtml:
